description: A few products and side projects I build to stay close to the craft.

projects.name: PLAYGRND
projects.description: A public amateur football record platform for leagues, matches, teams, players, claims, corrections, and organizer workflows.
highlights: SSR SvelteKit public app backed by a private Go API over local sockets
Postgres source-of-truth model with Redis snapshots and recomputable derived stats
WhatsApp magic-link onboarding, player claims, admin review, and scoped operational flows

projects.name: Memoato
projects.description: A personal memory and quantified-self app for fast capture, life tracking, and long-term searchable history.
highlights: Fast capture with natural language input
Built for consistency, not spreadsheet rituals

projects.name: PLAYGRND Draft
projects.description: A fast football draft game where you spin iconic national-team tournament squads, build an XI, simulate a tournament, and share the result.
highlights: World XI draft loop built for quick mobile sessions
Local-first gameplay with non-blocking share and stats
Fan-made PLAYGRND experiment with careful rights boundaries

projects.name: HILLS Lab
projects.description: An independent R&D studio focused on applied AI, Bitcoin, and commerce systems.
highlights: Small teams, clear ownership, production discipline
Focused on shipping and operating real systems

projects.name: XXI Today
projects.description: A sunsetted Bitcoin wallet and .btc domain explorer experiment, built around XVerse integration and simple lookup flows.
highlights: Fast .btc lookups and basic on-chain context
Useful learning project, no longer an active product bet

projects.name: Apes Club
projects.description: A sunsetted Solana token-launcher experiment focused on dashboards, creator rankings, and risk-aware meme-coin discovery.
highlights: Explored token-launch mechanics and creator analytics
Combined Web3 UX, dashboards, and discovery workflows
Archived as an experiment rather than an active roadmap item
